Desto Dubb, whose real name is Joshua Taylor, is a Los Angeles-born rapper, fashion designer, entrepreneur, and the founder and CEO of the popular streetwear brand That’s A Awful Lot Of Cough Syrup (ALOCS). Originally from Watts, California, Desto Dubb built his name through the West Coast hip-hop and fashion scenes, turning a small clothing hustle into a multimillion-dollar streetwear business. His journey began with selling clothes out of the back of his van in Downtown Los Angeles before expanding into multiple retail stores. Known for his bold designs, distinctive branding, and strong connections throughout the music industry, Desto has become one of the recognizable figures in modern West Coast streetwear culture. 

As the CEO of Awful Lot Of Cough Syrup, Desto Dubb has transformed his clothing line into a nationally recognized brand worn by major hip-hop artists, including Future and Young Thug. His relationships with artists and entertainers have helped push the brand beyond Los Angeles, making it a familiar name in hip-hop fashion. Beyond clothing, Desto is also a recording artist with connections to influential West Coast figures, including the late Drakeo The Ruler. His success has made him an example of how independent entrepreneurs can turn their creativity, music connections, and personal branding into a major business. From selling shirts in parking lots to running his own fashion company, Desto Dubb continues to build his legacy as both an artist and businessman.
